title: Privacy Policy
html:
Last updated: November 24, 2026

Korea Decoded (koreadecoded-blog.blogspot.com) explains Korean news, money and everyday words in plain English. This page explains what information is collected when you visit.

What we collect

We do not ask you to create an account and we do not collect your name or email address through this site. If you leave a comment, the name and text you choose to publish are shown with the comment and handled by Blogger.

Cookies and advertising

This blog runs on Google Blogger. Google may use cookies to measure traffic and, once ads are enabled, to show advertising through Google AdSense. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on visits to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.

You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings, and learn more at How Google uses information from sites that use its services.

Analytics

Blogger provides basic visit statistics (such as page views and referring sites). These are aggregated and do not identify you personally.

Links to other sites

Our articles link to news outlets, government pages and reference sites. Their own privacy policies apply when you visit them.

Children

This site is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect information from them.

Changes

If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be left as a comment on the About page.
